up: Find all unique compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5725593. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID and preferred name for each compound. Filter the docs table where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725593', then join to compound_records on doc_id, and finally join to molecule_dictionary on molregno to retrieve the molecule identifiers and names.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725593'
